input.title: From studio to street: everyday activewear styling
input.summary: Simple layers, balanced proportions and easy accessories take your favorite activewear from studio plans to everyday moments.
input.body:
Some days move from a studio session to coffee with friends, with little time for a complete outfit change. A few thoughtful styling choices can help your activewear feel at home throughout the day.

Start with a coordinated base

A matching top and leggings or shorts create an easy starting point. Choose a color you enjoy wearing, then keep the rest of the look simple. Tonal combinations make it easy to introduce another layer without competing details.

Add a relaxed layer

An open shirt, a roomy sweatshirt or a light jacket changes the silhouette of a fitted set. Balance close-fitting pieces with a looser layer, and choose a length that feels comfortable when you sit, walk or reach.

Finish with everyday details

Clean sneakers, a cap and a practical bag can bring the outfit together. Pick accessories around your plans rather than adding everything at once. One considered detail is often enough.

Make the look your own

Try different proportions and combinations using pieces already in your wardrobe. The goal is an outfit that feels comfortable and personal, whether you are heading to class or taking a slower afternoon.
